# Zapply Jobs — Canada Jobs 2027

> Curated entry-level, new-grad, and early-career job listings across Canada. Updated continuously by an automated pipeline.

## What this repo provides
- A README job table kept current by the Zapply pipeline: role, company, location, posting date, and direct apply link
- Roles from Canadian employers across major applicant-tracking systems
- Canada-focused, entry-level and early-career roles

## How to use
- Browse `README.md` — it is the canonical listing and regenerates continuously as the pipeline refreshes
- Apply links go directly to employer career pages
- This repo is display-only: it intentionally contains no raw data files

## Who maintains this
Zapply Jobs (zapplyjobs) — automated pipeline with human curation
